Signals: [DECIDE] needs a decision: confirm it with a severity, or dismiss it with a reason.
  [<SEVERITY>] becomes a finding at that severity unless dismissed with a reason; a confirmation keeps the severity.
  existing: the line is already on the target branch, so its finding is pre-existing; only a pre-existing signal
  can be confirmed as a crash, and a crash is a BLOCKER.
  Decide a signal; do not repeat it as a finding.
